p_note: Tolerant crop. Lower p to ~0.45 from heading to flowering where FAO-33 Ky is highest (0.60)
adaptation_note: FAO: larger Zr values for modelling or rainfed, smaller values for irrigation scheduling. Take the low end (1.5 m)

p_note: Fairly tolerant. Sensitive at flowering (April): lower p to ~0.50. No FAO-33 Ky available for rapeseed

Highly sensitive at flowering: FAO-33 Ky 1.50 for the flowering period (vs 0.40 vegetative, 0.50 yield formation, 0.20 ripening). Lower p to 0.40-0.45 from ~10 d before to ~20 d after female flowering
source: FAO-56 Table 22 (Maize field grain: Zr 1.0-1.7 p 0.55)

p_note: Sensitive crop (p 0.45 already low). FAO-33 Ky: 0.40 vegetative, 1.00 flowering, 0.80 yield formation. Keep p at 0.45 or lower to 0.40 at flowering
Very drought tolerant; regulated-deficit irrigation common; sensitive during fruit growth (Jul-Sep). No FAO-33 Ky
source: FAO-56 Table 22 (Olives 40-60 % ground coverage: Zr 1.2-1.7 p 0.65)

p_note: Tolerant; FAO-33 seasonal Ky for alfalfa 1.1. Irrigation rarely profitable except intensive grassland
source: FAO-56 Table 22 (Grazing pasture rotated: Zr 0.5-1.5 p 0.60; Alfalfa for hay: Zr 1.0-2.0 p 0.55)
adaptation_note: Perennial: Zr constant all year. Range widened from 0.6-1.0 to the FAO 0.5-1.5
